Stripe Payment Gateway

Stale Booking Expiry (15m)
Releases Unpaid Calendar Seats

Payment Hold Release (60m)
Releases Expired Gateway Authorizations

Payment Capture Retry (15m)
Retries Accepted Booking Captures

Booking and Balance Reminders (60m)
Automated Alerts

Data Retention Pruning (24h)
Prunes Old Sessions and Chat Logs

API Routers (51 Modular Routers)
(api and r routes)

Authentication and RBAC
(Dual JWT Domain and Role Checker)

Domain Services Layer (56 Services)
(Bookings, Payments, Tours, Ledgers, etc.)

WebSocket Hub (/api/ws/messages)
(Realtime Messaging and Live Notifications)

Next.js Proxy (src/proxy.ts)
Cookie Verification and Route Shield

Client-Side Portals (SPA)
Admin / Supplier / Agent / Affiliate / Customer

Web Browser / Mobile Client
(Desktop, Tablet, Mobile)
